question: How should all the sesame seeds be wrapped using the mantras beginning with Sadya?
premises: All sesame seeds are to be wrapped.
The mantras beginning with Sadya are employed.
inference: All the sesame seeds should be wrapped with cloth using the mantras beginning with Sadya.
uncertainties: vastraḥ form unusual; taken as instrumental sense
plain_english: And one should wrap all the sesame seeds with cloth, using the mantras beginning with Sadya.
